/*
EDARSAHUB V1.0
Principal tecnico Scheduler / Inventarios.

Objetivo:
- identidad tecnica no interactiva;
- rol dedicado de minimo privilegio;
- permiso unico inventarios:EJECUTAR;
- scope derivado exclusivamente de Unidades_Negocio activas;
- servidor compartido siempre discriminado por sucursal;
- sin ADMIN / SUPERADMIN;
- sin bypass RBAC.

La migracion es transaccional, idempotente y fail-closed.
*/

SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @UsuarioID INT;
    DECLARE @RolID INT;
    DECLARE @ModuloID INT;
    DECLARE @AccionID SMALLINT;

    SELECT @ModuloID = ModuloID
    FROM dbo.Usuario_Modulos
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CodigoModulo))) = 'INVENTARIOS'
      AND ISNULL(Activo, 1) = 1;

    SELECT @AccionID = AccionID
    FROM dbo.Usuario_Acciones
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CodigoAccion))) = 'EJECUTAR'
      AND ISNULL(Activo, 1) = 1;

    IF @ModuloID IS NULL OR @AccionID IS NULL
        THROW 51000, 'Contrato inventarios:EJECUTAR no encontrado.', 1;

    SELECT @UsuarioID = UsuarioID
    FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(CodigoUsuario,'')))) = 'SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS'
       OR UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(Username,'')))) = 'SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS';

    IF @UsuarioID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO dbo.Usuario_Catalogo (
            CodigoUsuario,
            Username,
            Email,
            Nombre,
            EsUsuarioPortal,
            RequiereMFA,
            PasswordTemporal,
            DebeCambiarPassword,
            IntentosFallidos,
            Bloqueado,
            Activo,
            PublicUUID
        )
        VALUES (
            'SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS',
            'SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS',
            'sys-sched-inventarios@edarsahub.internal',
            'Scheduler Inventarios',
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            1,
            1,
            NEWID()
        );

        SET @UsuarioID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    END;

    IF @UsuarioID IS NULL
        THROW 51000, 'No fue posible resolver principal tecnico de Inventarios.', 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo
        WHERE UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
          AND (
                 UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(CodigoUsuario,'')))) <> 'SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS'
              OR UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(Username,'')))) <> 'SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS'
              OR ISNULL(EsUsuarioPortal,1) <> 0
              OR ISNULL(Bloqueado,0) <> 1
              OR ISNULL(Activo,0) <> 1
          )
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Conflicto de identidad del principal tecnico de Inventarios.', 1;

    SELECT @RolID = RolID
    FROM dbo.Usuario_Roles
    WHERE UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(CodigoRol,'')))) = 'SCHEDULER_INVENTARIOS';

    IF @RolID IS NULL
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO dbo.Usuario_Roles (
            CodigoRol,
            NombreRol,
            Descripcion,
            EsRolSistema,
            Activo,
            NivelJerarquia
        )
        VALUES (
            'SCHEDULER_INVENTARIOS',
            'Scheduler Inventarios',
            'Rol tecnico no interactivo para analisis automatico de inventarios.',
            1,
            1,
            10
        );

        SET @RolID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
    END;

    IF @RolID IS NULL
        THROW 51000, 'No fue posible resolver rol tecnico de Inventarios.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion
        WHERE UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
          AND RolID = @RolID
          AND ISNULL(Activo,1) = 1
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion (
            UsuarioID,
            RolID,
            EsPrincipal,
            Activo
        )
        VALUES (@UsuarioID, @RolID, 1, 1);
    END;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion
        WHERE UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
          AND RolID <> @RolID
          AND ISNULL(Activo,1) = 1
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Principal tecnico de Inventarios posee roles adicionales.', 1;

    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo
        WHERE RolID = @RolID
          AND ModuloID = @ModuloID
          AND AccionID = @AccionID
          AND ISNULL(Activo,1) = 1
          AND ISNULL(Permitido,0) = 1
    )
    BEGIN
        INSERT INTO dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo (
            RolID,
            ModuloID,
            AccionID,
            Permitido,
            RestriccionPropietario,
            RestriccionSucursal,
            RequiereAutorizacion,
            Activo
        )
        VALUES (
            @RolID,
            @ModuloID,
            @AccionID,
            1,
            0,
            1,
            0,
            1
        );
    END;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo
        WHERE RolID = @RolID
          AND ISNULL(Activo,1) = 1
          AND ISNULL(Permitido,0) = 1
          AND NOT (
              ModuloID = @ModuloID
              AND AccionID = @AccionID
          )
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Rol tecnico de Inventarios posee permisos adicionales.', 1;

    DECLARE @ActiveUnits TABLE (
        ServidorID UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL,
        SucursalCodigo NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        ActiveUnitsOnServer BIGINT NOT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @ActiveUnits (
        ServidorID,
        SucursalCodigo,
        ActiveUnitsOnServer
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, u.server_id),
        NULLIF(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(
                TRY_CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), u.sucursal_origen_id)
            )),
            ''
        ),
        COUNT_BIG(*) OVER (PARTITION BY u.server_id)
    FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio AS u
    WHERE ISNULL(u.activo,0) = 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM @ActiveUnits
        WHERE ServidorID IS NULL
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Existe unidad activa con server_id no canonico.', 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM @ActiveUnits
        WHERE ActiveUnitsOnServer > 1
          AND SucursalCodigo IS NULL
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Servidor compartido activo sin sucursal_origen_id.', 1;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion (
        UsuarioID,
        ServidorID,
        Activo,
        Observaciones
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @UsuarioID,
        au.ServidorID,
        1,
        'Scheduler Inventarios V1.0 - scope canonico'
    FROM @ActiveUnits AS au
    WHERE au.ActiveUnitsOnServer = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion AS usa
          WHERE usa.UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
            AND usa.ServidorID = au.ServidorID
            AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1) = 1
      );

    INSERT INTO dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion (
        UsuarioID,
        ServidorID,
        SucursalCodigo,
        Activo,
        Observaciones
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT
        @UsuarioID,
        au.ServidorID,
        au.SucursalCodigo,
        1,
        'Scheduler Inventarios V1.0 - scope canonico'
    FROM @ActiveUnits AS au
    WHERE au.ActiveUnitsOnServer > 1
      AND au.SucursalCodigo IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion AS usa
          WHERE usa.UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
            AND usa.ServidorID = au.ServidorID
            AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(usa.SucursalCodigo))) =
                UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(au.SucursalCodigo)))
            AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1) = 1
      );

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion AS usa
        WHERE usa.UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
          AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1) = 1
          AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM @ActiveUnits AS au
              WHERE au.ServidorID = usa.ServidorID
                AND au.ActiveUnitsOnServer > 1
          )
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Principal de Inventarios tiene servidor compartido sin discriminacion de sucursal.', 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion AS usa
        WHERE usa.UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
          AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1) = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM @ActiveUnits AS au
              WHERE au.ServidorID = usa.ServidorID
                AND au.ActiveUnitsOnServer = 1
          )
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Principal de Inventarios tiene scope de servidor fuera del universo activo.', 1;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion AS usa
        WHERE usa.UsuarioID = @UsuarioID
          AND ISNULL(usa.Activo,1) = 1
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM @ActiveUnits AS au
              WHERE au.ServidorID = usa.ServidorID
                AND au.ActiveUnitsOnServer > 1
                AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(au.SucursalCodigo))) =
                    UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(usa.SucursalCodigo)))
          )
    )
        THROW 51000, 'Principal de Inventarios tiene scope de sucursal fuera del universo activo.', 1;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    SELECT
        @UsuarioID AS UsuarioID,
        @RolID AS RolID,
        @ModuloID AS ModuloID,
        @AccionID AS AccionID,
        'PASS' AS Resultado;

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    THROW;
END CATCH;

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

import core.auth.sql_user_identity as identity
from core.inventory_analysis_core import InventoryAnalysisCore
from core.rbac_sql.service import RBACSQLService


def test_inventarios_scheduler_uses_dedicated_principal(monkeypatch):
    captured = {}

    def fake_principal(code):
        captured["code"] = code
        return {
            "UsuarioID": 77,
            "CodigoUsuario": code,
        }

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        identity,
        "resolve_system_principal_current_user",
        fake_principal,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        RBACSQLService,
        "can_access_permission",
        lambda usuario_id, permission: (
            usuario_id == 77
            and permission
            == identity.INVENTARIOS_SCHEDULER_PERMISSION_CODE
        ),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        identity,
        "_resolve_system_principal_empresa_uuids",
        lambda usuario_id: ["empresa-uuid-1"] if usuario_id == 77 else [],
    )

    result = identity.resolve_inventarios_scheduler_current_user()

    assert captured["code"] == "SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS"
    assert result["UsuarioID"] == 77
    assert result["CodigoUsuario"] == "SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS"
    assert result["empresas_permitidas"] == ["empresa-uuid-1"]


def test_inventarios_scheduler_fails_closed_without_permission(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        identity,
        "resolve_system_principal_current_user",
        lambda code: {
            "UsuarioID": 77,
            "CodigoUsuario": code,
        },
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        RBACSQLService,
        "can_access_permission",
        lambda usuario_id, permission: False,
    )

    with pytest.raises(identity.SystemPrincipalResolutionError):
        identity.resolve_inventarios_scheduler_current_user()


def test_inventarios_scheduler_fails_closed_without_scope(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        identity,
        "resolve_system_principal_current_user",
        lambda code: {
            "UsuarioID": 77,
            "CodigoUsuario": code,
        },
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        RBACSQLService,
        "can_access_permission",
        lambda usuario_id, permission: True,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        identity,
        "_resolve_system_principal_empresa_uuids",
        lambda usuario_id: [],
    )

    with pytest.raises(identity.SystemPrincipalResolutionError):
        identity.resolve_inventarios_scheduler_current_user()


def test_inventory_analysis_core_defaults_to_canonical_service_principal(
    monkeypatch,
):
    expected = {
        "UsuarioID": 77,
        "CodigoUsuario": "SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS",
        "empresas_permitidas": ["empresa-uuid-1"],
    }

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        identity,
        "resolve_inventarios_scheduler_current_user",
        lambda: expected,
    )

    core = InventoryAnalysisCore(db_client=object())

    assert core._mock_user == expected


def test_inventory_analysis_core_preserves_explicit_user(monkeypatch):
    explicit = {
        "UsuarioID": 8,
        "email": "user@example.test",
    }

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        identity,
        "resolve_inventarios_scheduler_current_user",
        lambda: pytest.fail("resolver must not run for explicit user"),
    )

    core = InventoryAnalysisCore(
        db_client=object(),
        mock_user=explicit,
    )

    assert core._mock_user is explicit


def test_inventory_scheduler_migration_contract_is_minimum_privilege():
    root = Path("/app/backend/database/migrations")
    migration = (
        root
        / "20261027_001_scheduler_inventarios_service_principal.sql"
    ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    assert "SYS-SCHED-INVENTARIOS" in migration
    assert "SCHEDULER_INVENTARIOS" in migration
    assert "'INVENTARIOS'" in migration
    assert "'EJECUTAR'" in migration
    assert "Unidades_Negocio" in migration
    assert "Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion" in migration
    assert "Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion" in migration
    assert "SUPERADMIN" not in migration
    assert "SYS-SCHED-ALERTAS" not in migration
    assert "UsuarioID = 27" not in migration
